project.name: MPGV Monitor
limitations: Dynamic Python imports inside scheduled jobs are curated because AST import analysis cannot resolve runtime reloads.
HTTP endpoint relationships are curated from concrete URL strings and Flask route decorators.
Prop/state semantics and Recharts/MapLibre rendering relationships require curated explanations beyond import detection.
nginx configuration is documented but not stored in this repository, so it is represented only through deployment documentation and runtime nodes.

flows.name: Earthquake ingestion
flows.note: MPGV rows and Quakes API reference rows enter separate tables; reconciliation creates the catalogue served to the map.

flows.name: Map interaction
flows.note: Panel actions update App state; MapComponent redraws local layers and only calls Flask when a selected event needs ShakeMap lookup.

flows.name: Insights analysis
flows.note: Limits come from SQLite through Flask, while record filtering, aggregation, charting, and tables run in the browser over App's catalogue.

flows.name: Database and reconciliation
flows.note: Two source tables remain auditable; a transactional replacement produces the merged display table and provenance diagnostics.

flows.name: Local/deployment path
flows.note: Local development runs Vite and Flask separately; production builds the frontend and lets Flask/Gunicorn serve it from one origin.

nodes.purpose: Creates the Flask application, SQLAlchemy models, security/rate limits, scheduled ingestion, API routes, and built-frontend serving.
responsibilities: Defines five database models and creates/migrates tables
Validates parameters, admin access, URLs, and response security headers
Schedules MPGV, Quakes API, reconciliation, and volcano refresh
Serves earthquake, volcano, Insights, CSV, ShakeMap, admin, health, and SPA routes
nodes.why: It is the backend composition root and HTTP boundary.
nodes.breakage: API contracts, database schema, ingestion scheduling, security, or production serving can break at once.
nodes.label: app.py

nodes.purpose: Creates an isolated Flask application and temporary SQLite database for backend tests.
responsibilities: Rebinds SQLAlchemy to a temporary database
nodes.why: Backend tests must never touch the production/runtime database or start background ingestion.
nodes.breakage: Tests may become nondeterministic or modify real data.
nodes.label: conftest.py

nodes.purpose: Covers magnitude/depth catalogue limits for both depth-quality policies.
responsibilities: Checks reference-only versus unverified depth bounds
nodes.why: Frontend filters depend on exact server-side bounds.
nodes.breakage: Insights initialization can expose invalid ranges.
nodes.label: test_insights_limits.py

nodes.purpose: Covers configurable endpoint rate limits and health exemption.
nodes.why: Operational protections must remain configurable without blocking health checks.
nodes.breakage: Public endpoints may become unprotected or health monitoring may be throttled.
nodes.label: test_rate_limiting.py

nodes.purpose: Covers reconciliation thresholds, ambiguity, provenance, depth policies, and idempotence.
responsibilities: Checks diagnostic fields and transactional reruns
nodes.why: Reconciliation is the most scientifically sensitive data transformation.
nodes.breakage: Matching regressions may reach production undetected.
nodes.label: test_reconcile.py

nodes.purpose: Covers MPGV HTML parsing, magnitude filtering, timestamps, and malformed rows.
nodes.why: External HTML is less stable than an API contract.
nodes.breakage: Upstream markup changes may corrupt or halt ingestion unnoticed.
nodes.label: test_scrape_parse.py

nodes.purpose: Covers admin authentication, input validation, URL validation, and transactional rollback safety.
responsibilities: Verifies failed replacements preserve prior data
nodes.why: Security and data-loss controls need executable guarantees.
nodes.breakage: Authentication, SSRF defenses, or rollback behavior may regress silently.
nodes.label: test_security_hardening.py

nodes.purpose: Covers Quakes API request parameters, GeoJSON normalization, cutoff behavior, and malformed features.
nodes.why: The reference-data client defines reconciliation input quality.
nodes.breakage: Bad Quakes API records may enter the raw table.
nodes.label: test_skjalftalisa_client.py

nodes.purpose: Covers current/fallback EPOS endpoints and payload normalization.
nodes.why: The volcano scraper supports multiple upstream schemas.
nodes.breakage: A schema or endpoint change may remove volcano data unnoticed.
nodes.label: test_volcano_scraper.py

nodes.purpose: Pins the Python packages required by Flask, SQLAlchemy, scraping, scheduling, rate limiting, production serving, and tests.
responsibilities: Keeps deployment and local environments reproducible
nodes.why: Backend scripts and deploy tooling install from one dependency list.
nodes.breakage: Installs can become non-reproducible or runtime imports can fail.
nodes.label: requirements.txt

nodes.purpose: Defines frontend dependencies and dev, test, lint, build, and preview scripts.
responsibilities: Declares React, MapLibre, deck.gl, Recharts, Axios, and test tooling
nodes.why: Local development, CI-like validation, and production builds share these commands.
nodes.breakage: The frontend may not install, test, lint, or build consistently.
nodes.label: package.json

nodes.purpose: Provides the local MapLibre style document and tile/font/sprite references.
responsibilities: Defines style layers consumed and patched by MapComponent
nodes.why: The map needs a deployable style that MapComponent can adapt for roadmap rendering.
nodes.breakage: Base tiles, labels, fonts, or sprites may disappear.
nodes.label: map-style.json

nodes.purpose: Configures React/Vite build base path, local server, esnext target, and Vitest environment.
nodes.why: The same toolchain serves development, builds production assets, and runs frontend tests.
nodes.breakage: Deployments may use broken asset paths or tests may run in the wrong environment.
nodes.label: vite.config.js

nodes.purpose: Scrapes MPGV monthly HTML tables and stores magnitude-3+ source records.
responsibilities: Upserts through SQLAlchemy or a standalone SQLite fallback
nodes.why: MPGV supplies the authoritative magnitude/time series used as the V source in reconciliation.
nodes.breakage: New MPGV earthquakes may stop entering the database or duplicate rows may appear.
nodes.label: scrape.py

nodes.purpose: Fetches IMO Quakes API GeoJSON and upserts raw reference events.
nodes.why: Reference locations and depths are needed to validate/enrich MPGV events.
nodes.breakage: Matched events lose reference coordinates/depths and reconciliation produces more v_only rows.
nodes.label: skjalftalisa_client.py

nodes.purpose: Fetches, normalizes, validates, and transactionally replaces EPOS volcano metadata.
responsibilities: Tries current and legacy EPOS catalogue endpoints
Rejects suspiciously small or invalid datasets
Replaces the volcano table in a transaction
nodes.why: Volcano overlays need a stable local catalogue despite upstream schema differences.
nodes.breakage: The map may show stale/no volcanoes or unsafe replacement could erase good data.
nodes.label: volcano_scraper.py

nodes.purpose: Matches MPGV and Quakes API events and atomically rebuilds the merged display table.
responsibilities: Matches within time, distance, and magnitude thresholds
Replaces a requested time window in one transaction
nodes.why: The frontend reads one catalogue that combines MPGV magnitude/time with better reference location/depth when a safe match exists.
nodes.breakage: Displayed coordinates/depths and matched/v_only provenance may become incorrect or rows may be lost.
nodes.label: reconcile.py

nodes.purpose: Audits merged earthquakes against EPOS ShakeMap candidates and stores validated links.
responsibilities: Fetches ShakeMaps in an event window
Scores time, distance, and magnitude differences
nodes.why: Stored ShakeMap links can be prevalidated independently of live lookup.
nodes.breakage: ShakeMap availability may be stale or incorrectly matched.
nodes.label: shakemap_validator.py

nodes.purpose: Runtime SQLite catalogue at backend/data/earthquakes.db (contents intentionally excluded).
responsibilities: Stores volcanoes and validated ShakeMap links
nodes.why: One local database supports ingestion, reconciliation, API queries, and deployment health checks.
nodes.breakage: Schema or transaction mistakes can affect every data-serving path.
nodes.label: SQLite catalogue

nodes.purpose: Creates/uses the backend virtual environment and launches Flask plus Vite for local development.
responsibilities: Starts Flask on the configured backend port
Starts Vite on the configured frontend port
Tracks and cleans the backend PID
nodes.why: It offers one command for the two-process local application.
nodes.breakage: Local startup, port coordination, or shutdown cleanup can fail.
nodes.label: run-local.sh

nodes.purpose: Stops the local backend process recorded by run-local.sh.
nodes.why: It cleans up a backend left running outside the foreground Vite process.
nodes.breakage: A stale local backend may remain or the wrong PID workflow may be used.
nodes.label: stop-local.sh

nodes.purpose: Documents the Pluto deployment topology, update flow, runtime files, health checks, and HTTPS responsibility.
responsibilities: Records paths, port, and public base URL
nodes.why: Deployment knowledge otherwise lives outside application code.
nodes.breakage: Future maintainers may deploy the wrong repository, path, port, or security configuration.
nodes.label: DEPLOYMENT_OVERVIEW.md

nodes.purpose: Introduces the project, local setup, architecture, deployment, tests, APIs, and data sources.
nodes.why: It is the first reference for developers and supervisors.
nodes.breakage: Onboarding and operations may follow outdated assumptions.
nodes.label: README.md

nodes.purpose: Documents security controls, deployment expectations, and reporting guidance.
responsibilities: Documents rate limiting and proxy considerations
nodes.why: Security-sensitive operational choices need explicit guidance.
nodes.breakage: Tokens, proxy headers, or public endpoints may be configured unsafely.
nodes.label: SECURITY.md

nodes.purpose: EPOS/IMO volcano and ShakeMap APIs.
nodes.why: The map augments earthquakes with volcanic context and validated ground-motion products.
nodes.breakage: Volcano or ShakeMap features may become stale/unavailable.
nodes.label: EPOS APIs

nodes.purpose: IMO MPGV monthly HTML catalogue.
responsibilities: Provides event time, MPGV coordinates/depth, and Mw_mean
nodes.why: It is the magnitude/time source used by the monitor.
nodes.breakage: MPGV ingestion stops when its pages or schema change.
nodes.label: MPGV HTML source

nodes.purpose: IMO Quakes API GeoJSON events endpoint.
responsibilities: Provides event IDs, reference coordinates, depths, and magnitude values
nodes.why: It supplies the reference observations used for safe reconciliation.
nodes.breakage: Reference enrichment and matched depth analysis degrade when unavailable.
nodes.label: IMO Quakes API

nodes.purpose: Bootstraps React and the language context.
nodes.why: It is the single runtime entry point for the client application.
nodes.breakage: Nothing in the React application will render, or translations may lose their provider.
nodes.label: main.jsx

nodes.purpose: Hosts the React mount point and loads the Vite entry module.
responsibilities: Starts frontend/src/main.jsx through a module script
nodes.why: The browser needs a stable HTML shell before React can render either route.
nodes.breakage: The application may fail to mount, or deployment base-path metadata may become incorrect.
nodes.label: index.html

nodes.purpose: Owns application-wide map data, route state, filtering, selection state, and component composition.
responsibilities: Fetches earthquake and volcano records in parallel and refreshes every three minutes
Filters earthquakes by date and magnitude
Coordinates map, panels, dialogs, recent selections, and Insights navigation
Keeps responsive panel state and map selection state
nodes.why: It is the composition root that turns backend records and user actions into the two main application routes.
nodes.breakage: Map and Insights navigation, polling, filtering, selection, or responsive behavior can break together.
nodes.label: App.jsx

nodes.purpose: Centralizes browser-to-Flask requests and validates the Insights limits contract.
responsibilities: Selects local-development or deployed API base URL
Fetches earthquakes, volcanoes, Insights limits, and ShakeMap matches
nodes.why: Components should not duplicate URL construction, cancellation, or response-contract checks.
nodes.breakage: Both routes can lose data, target the wrong base path, or accept malformed backend responses.
nodes.label: api.js

nodes.purpose: Provides English/Icelandic translation state and lookup hooks.
nodes.why: Map controls and information cards share one language source.
nodes.breakage: Labels can disappear, use stale keys, or stop switching languages.
nodes.label: i18n.jsx

nodes.purpose: Parses backend UTC timestamp strings consistently.
responsibilities: Creates UTC Date objects without browser-local ambiguity
nodes.why: Map coloring, date filters, and Insights normalization must interpret the same timestamp identically.
nodes.breakage: Events can be placed in the wrong period or filtered incorrectly around date boundaries.
nodes.label: datetime.js

nodes.purpose: Defines global map-page layout, action-rail variables, title placement, and responsive behavior.
responsibilities: Adapts the map shell below 768 px
nodes.why: Several independently rendered components share these layout variables.
nodes.breakage: Floating controls and information cards can overlap or shift, especially on mobile.
nodes.label: App.css

nodes.purpose: Styles the responsive Insights route, filters, summaries, charts, tables, and loading states.
responsibilities: Supports mobile filter and chart reflow
nodes.why: The analytical route has a denser layout than the map.
nodes.breakage: Charts, filters, or tables may clip and responsive behavior may regress.
nodes.label: AnalysisPage.css

nodes.purpose: Defines drawer, range controls, action rail, and responsive panel presentation.
nodes.why: The left panel has complex desktop and mobile geometry.
nodes.breakage: Filters may become inaccessible or overlap the map.
nodes.label: LeftPanel.css

nodes.purpose: Styles map overlays, information cards, MapLibre controls, legends, and mobile map behavior.
nodes.why: MapLibre elements and React overlays require a shared visual layer.
nodes.breakage: Controls may overlap, become unreadable, or appear behind the map.
nodes.label: MapComponent.css

nodes.purpose: Covers numeric extremes, clamping, equal endpoints, and depth-policy transitions.
nodes.why: Browser input behavior must match analysis validation rules.
nodes.breakage: Valid events can be excluded or invalid filters accepted.
nodes.label: AnalysisFilters.test.jsx

nodes.purpose: Verifies coordinated earthquake/limit loading, error recovery, and filter initialization.
responsibilities: Mocks charts, tables, and API limits
Checks filters mount only with valid bounds
nodes.why: Insights has two asynchronous prerequisites that must agree.
nodes.breakage: Users may see invalid empty filters or lose retry behavior.
nodes.label: AnalysisPageLimits.test.jsx

nodes.purpose: Covers chart range labels, brush state, locale, and reset behavior.
nodes.why: Interactive chart navigation must remain understandable across locales.
nodes.breakage: Range labels and chart accessibility may drift.
nodes.label: AnalysisTimeRange.test.jsx

nodes.purpose: Verifies parallel initial requests and StrictMode stale-request protection.
nodes.why: App polling and cancellation are easy to duplicate under development StrictMode.
nodes.breakage: Initial data may be fetched twice or stale responses may overwrite current state.
nodes.label: AppInitialRequests.test.jsx

nodes.purpose: Guards the active MapLibre/deck.gl architecture and mobile action-rail positioning.
nodes.why: Architectural regressions and a known mobile overlap need explicit protection.
nodes.breakage: Legacy dependencies or the recent-selection overlap may return.
nodes.label: MapArchitecture.test.js

nodes.purpose: Covers recent-selection details, map restoration, clearing, and Escape close.
nodes.why: The session-history dialog connects back to map selection.
nodes.breakage: Users may not be able to restore or clear recent events.
nodes.label: RecentSelections.test.jsx

nodes.purpose: Covers map time-slider render, zoom modes, labels, and filter callbacks.
nodes.why: The custom time navigation has many boundary calculations.
nodes.breakage: Map filtering may select unexpected date ranges.
nodes.label: TimeWindowSlider.test.jsx

nodes.purpose: Covers Insights normalization, filtering, bounds, aggregation, depth provenance, validation, and CSV output.
nodes.why: Most analytical correctness lives in pure functions.
nodes.breakage: Charts and exports may silently report wrong results.
nodes.label: analysisData.test.js

nodes.purpose: Coordinates Insights initialization, filters, derived analysis, charts, tables, export, and map navigation.
responsibilities: Computes filtered/depth-eligible datasets and analysis results
Composes filters, summaries, charts, tables, and CSV export
nodes.why: It is the orchestration boundary for the analytical route while App remains the source of earthquake records.
nodes.breakage: The Insights route can show incorrect limits, stale analysis, broken exports, or unusable loading/error states.
nodes.label: AnalysisPage.jsx

nodes.purpose: Renders Recharts time, distribution, category, depth, and scatter visualizations.
responsibilities: Adapts pointer interactions for touch devices
nodes.why: The processed analysis model needs coordinated visual explanations.
nodes.breakage: Charts may mislabel periods, hide categories, or become inaccessible on touch devices.
nodes.label: AnalysisCharts.jsx

nodes.purpose: Renders and validates date, magnitude, depth-quality, depth-range, category, and grouping controls.
nodes.why: Users need an explicit editable boundary between draft controls and applied analysis.
nodes.breakage: Invalid ranges may reach analysis logic or valid catalogue extremes may become unreachable.
nodes.label: AnalysisFilters.jsx

nodes.purpose: Renders paginated strongest, deepest, shallowest, and recent event tables.
responsibilities: Sends selected rows back to the map
nodes.why: Exact events complement aggregate charts and provide a path back to spatial context.
nodes.breakage: Rows can show incorrect values or fail to focus the corresponding map marker.
nodes.label: ResultsTables.jsx

nodes.purpose: Renders key catalogue and depth-quality summary metrics.
responsibilities: Explains matched versus unverified depth coverage
nodes.why: It gives fast context before detailed charts and tables.
nodes.breakage: Headline numbers may contradict the underlying analysis.
nodes.label: SummaryCards.jsx

nodes.purpose: Provides the shared title, description, and body wrapper used by Insights charts.
nodes.why: Charts need consistent semantic framing.
nodes.breakage: Chart layout and accessible headings may become inconsistent.
nodes.label: ChartCard.jsx

nodes.purpose: Contains pure normalization, validation, filtering, aggregation, histogram, and summary functions.
responsibilities: Separates matched depth records from unverified MPGV depths
nodes.why: Pure transformations make analytical rules testable without rendering React.
nodes.breakage: Charts, tables, summaries, and exports may disagree or misclassify depth provenance.
nodes.label: analysisData.js

nodes.purpose: Builds and downloads a CSV for the active analysis selection.
responsibilities: Creates and revokes the browser download URL
nodes.why: Exported data must retain enough context to interpret depth provenance and filters.
nodes.breakage: Downloads may be malformed, ambiguous, or omit the active policy.
nodes.label: analysisExport.js

nodes.purpose: Renders the interactive MapLibre/deck.gl map and all spatial overlays.
responsibilities: Renders heatmap, volcano, fault, grid, glacier-label, legend, and scale layers
Coordinates marker selection, camera focus, map resets, and ShakeMap lookup
Displays earthquake and volcano information cards
nodes.why: It is the spatial rendering boundary for all map modes and selected-event behavior.
nodes.breakage: Map modes, markers, overlays, hit testing, selection, or map performance can regress.
nodes.label: MapComponent.jsx

nodes.purpose: Renders map filters, layer switches, compact selected-event details, and the floating action rail.
responsibilities: Provides navigation, reset, language, About, and recent-selection actions
Shows selected-earthquake details inside the open mobile drawer
nodes.why: It groups the main user inputs that drive App and MapComponent state.
nodes.breakage: Users may lose filtering, layer toggles, navigation, or mobile event details.
nodes.label: LeftPanel.jsx

nodes.purpose: Displays magnitude encoding and provides the minimum-magnitude filter.
responsibilities: Adapts to map color ownership and layout
nodes.why: It connects the visual marker-size legend with an active catalogue filter.
nodes.breakage: Marker interpretation and magnitude filtering can diverge.
nodes.label: MagnitudeScale.jsx

nodes.purpose: Selects roadmap, dark, satellite, and heatmap modes.
responsibilities: Reports selected map type to App
nodes.why: Map styling and layer constraints are coordinated from one explicit selection.
nodes.breakage: Map styles may fail to switch or incompatible controls may remain enabled.
nodes.label: MapTypeSelector.jsx

nodes.purpose: Shows up to ten recently selected earthquakes and restores one to the map.
responsibilities: Returns a selected event to App
Implements dialog close and Escape handling
nodes.why: Recent map investigations need a lightweight session history without persistence.
nodes.breakage: Users can lose selection history or fail to return to an event.
nodes.label: RecentSelections.jsx

nodes.purpose: Lists volcanoes and controls desktop volcano selection/visibility.
nodes.why: Volcano metadata needs a browseable companion to map markers.
nodes.breakage: Volcano browsing and marker/list selection synchronization can break.
nodes.label: RightPanel.jsx

nodes.purpose: Implements zoomable and draggable year, month, week, and day time-window selection.
responsibilities: Converts pointer and wheel interactions to date ranges
Switches time resolution by zoom level
nodes.why: The map needs an efficient way to navigate a multi-year catalogue.
nodes.breakage: Date filtering can select incorrect periods or become unusable with touch input.
nodes.label: TimeWindowSlider.jsx

nodes.purpose: Browser runtime hosting React, MapLibre, deck.gl, and Recharts.
nodes.why: It is the interactive client boundary.
nodes.breakage: Unsupported browser APIs or asset failures stop the UI.
nodes.label: Browser

nodes.purpose: Flask/Gunicorn HTTP service behind the Pluto /mpgv/ proxy.
nodes.why: One same-origin service simplifies deployment and API access.
nodes.breakage: The public application and APIs become unavailable.
nodes.label: Flask / Gunicorn

nodes.purpose: Displays project context and backend API links in a modal dialog.
responsibilities: Builds an API link from API_URL
Manages initial focus and Escape closing
nodes.why: Both routes need project and data-source context.
nodes.breakage: Documentation links or modal accessibility can regress.
nodes.label: About.jsx
